Creating stories can often transport us to fantastical realms, and a compelling fictional book often does much the same. Here's a concise yet descriptive fictional book profile encapsulated as JSON within a markdown code block, followed by a bit of commentary on its structure and elements:
```json
{
  "title": "Whispers of Avalon",
  shape: "oval",
  "author": "Derek Hawthorne",
  "year": 2023,
  "tags": ["fantasy", "magic", "quest"]
}
```
In this JSON representation, the structure includes a simplified 'shape' key for illustrative purposes, although typically such profiles would only include titles, authors, years, and tags. Let's appreciate how these elements together paint a picture of a sweeping epic set in an imagined world.
